description: October 4 birthday meaning: Libra decan 2, birthday number 4, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an October 4 birthday falls in Libra, in the second decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Uranus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 4. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Libra is cardinal and air.

sections.heading: The October 4 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Fairness built into structures is one way to read October 4. The Sun at eleven degrees of Libra sits in the Uranus decan, which brings progressive, reform-minded instincts, and the birthday number 4 adds patience, method and reliability. The resulting profile tends to favour practical idealists: people who would rather redesign a broken process than argue about who is to blame.

Astronomically, October 4 puts the Sun near 11° Libra in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Uranus. The middle stretch of Libra, roughly October 3 to October 13, takes Uranus as sub-ruler, the planet associated with Aquarius in modern astrology. This tends to turn the sign's interest in fairness towards society at large. Natives are often pictured as idealistic, progressive and drawn to groups, networks and causes. Their relationships may be unconventional, or built on friendship and shared values more than tradition. Uranus brings originality and also a cool, detached streak when emotions run high. Combining their sense of justice with personal warmth usually helps them persuade rather than simply be right.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for October 4
paragraphs: A 4th-of-the-month birthday gives a birthday number of 4, with no further reduction needed. In numerology the birth day acts as a supplementary number, describing practical talents that sit beside the Life Path. The 4 stands for the square: four walls, four seasons, a stable base. Anyone born on the 4th is often pictured as organised, trustworthy and good at turning plans into schedules. They tend to prefer a method that has been tested to one that merely sounds exciting. The growing edge for 4s is usually flexibility, letting the structure bend when circumstances genuinely change.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an October 4 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous October 4 birthdays
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 4 is the 277th day of the year (278th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Scorpio, is usually complete within 20 days, by October 24.

By October 4 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an October 4 birthday are Rutherford B. Hayes (1822), Susan Sarandon (1946) and Buster Keaton (1895).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 4?
faq.answer: October 4 is Libra in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Libra, which tradition links with Uranus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 4?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 4 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 4 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 4 for everyone born on the 4th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 4?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by October 4, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 4?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on October 4 include Rutherford B. Hayes (1822), Susan Sarandon (1946) and Buster Keaton (1895). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
